trust_decision.summary: MapMessage JSON output must never contain a bare non-finite floating-point literal: NaN/Infinity must be emitted as quoted JSON strings (Jackson WRITE_NAN_AS_STRINGS semantics), decided in the single package-private serializer MapMessageJsonFormatter that MapMessage.asJson delegates to.

landing_point.why: The summary names non-finite floating-point values in MapMessage JSON; the first code an engineer finds is formatNumber, whose Double and Float branches append the raw value (lines 237-242).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver who reproduces the report with a scalar double can dismiss formatFloatArray/formatDoubleArray as 'a different, array-formatting feature that the example does not mention' and the formatNumber else-branch as 'an exotic custom Number type'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Finite doubles/floats and integral Numbers must stay bare JSON numbers: only non-finite values become strings. An over-broad fix that quotes every double (or routes BigDecimal/BigInteger through formatString, or changes the longValue()/doubleValue() comparison in the fallback branch) breaks the pinned tests and changes the JSON type of valid numeric fields.

O6_input_shapes: arbitrary Number subtype resolved through doubleValue() in the formatNumber fallback branch
the same values nested inside Map/List/Collection/Object[] (reached by recursion into formatNumber)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A new public writeNumber overload or a new numeric branch in writeNumber(Number) that repeats the pre-existing isFinite guard only for some types
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: JsonWriter is the implementation the MapMessage fix copied verbatim (same WRITE_NAN_AS_STRINGS comment); a maintainer adding a numeric type or overload here would copy one branch and can plausibly omit the guard on the new one.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: GELF map/mdc field writer emitting numeric MapMessage values as raw JSON numbers instead of quoted strings
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: GELF defines additional fields as typed values, so a maintainer could switch FieldWriter from String.valueOf to a Number-aware writer for numeric fields and would then need exactly this finite check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A new numeric branch (e.g. BigInteger, added for parity with JsonWriter.java:682-684) inserted into formatNumber's else chain
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: MapMessageJsonFormatter already differs from JsonWriter by lacking a BigInteger branch; a maintainer closing that gap would edit precisely this chain and could add the branch without the finite handling.

O9_family: improper_encoding (CWE-116): non-finite floating-point values serialized as bare NaN/Infinity tokens, producing invalid JSON

O10_build.toolchain: Maven multi-module build with the checked-in Maven wrapper (mvnw, .mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties); JDK 17 per .java-version

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a Double.isFinite/Float.isFinite quotation check only inside formatNumber's Double and Float branches, reproducing the report's scalar example and stopping once that path prints "NaN".

out_of_scope_notes: log4j-layout-template-json's JsonWriter.java:724-740 already implements the identical finite check (with its own tests at JsonWriterTest.java:611-643) and is the source the MapMessage fix copies; it needs no change for this advisory and was not pursued further.
